_comment: DYST config template — ALL possible keys with hints. Copy to a sidecar file (same base name, .json or .txt) for per-file overrides, or use as the global config.json reference. Loop/global keys (tick_seconds, odds, autostart, ...) only apply in config.json; display/audio/scale keys apply per-file via sidecars.

_hints.odds: 1 in N chance per tick (must be >= 1). Default 1000 = 0.1% per tick.
_hints.max_concurrent: max overlays playing at once; 0 = unlimited. Default 3.
_hints.reroll_in_same_tick: on a success, re-roll immediately within the same tick (burst). Locked true in v1. Default true.
_hints.media_folder: relative path (from app dir) to the media root. Default 'media'. Subfolders media/images/ and media/videos/ are scanned; sidecar audio + settings live in the same subfolder.
_hints.image_display_seconds: how long a still image stays up (seconds). Default 1.0.
_hints.fade_out_seconds: fade-out at end of playback (seconds). Renamed from 'fade_seconds'; the old name still works as a deprecated alias. Default 0.2. Images fade out; videos end instantly (no fade).
_hints.fade_in_seconds: fade-in (seconds): image/gif fades in from transparent BEFORE the display clock starts (lifetime = fade_in + display + fade_out). 0 = no fade-in. Scales with speed. Videos ignore it.
_hints.opacity: overlay transparency 0.0-1.0. 1.0 = fully opaque (default), 0.0 = invisible. Composes with fade animations.
_hints.max_duration: hard cap in seconds (>= 0; 0 = no cap) for ANY overlay + its audio. When it fires, the video/image/gif AND its sidecar audio STOP INSTANTLY and the overlay closes with NO fade-out. Per-file sidecar overrides global; a per-file 0 explicitly disables a global cap.
_hints.speed: playback speed multiplier (> 0). 1.0 = normal, 2 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half. Applies to videos (frame rate + own audio), GIF animation, sidecar audio, AND image display time + fades (all timings scale by 1/speed). With pitch == 1.0 audio speeds tape-style (pitch rises with speed); with pitch != 1.0 speed and pitch are independent (audio baked via ffmpeg).
_hints.pitch: audio pitch multiplier (> 0). 1.0 = normal, 2 = an octave up, 0.5 = an octave down. Applies to sidecar audio and video embedded audio (extracted + re-encoded). Independent of speed. Requires ffmpeg.
_hints.speed_pitch: combined speed+pitch (>= 0; 0 = off): sets BOTH speed and pitch to this value, OVERRIDING the individual keys (per-file > global). 0 = use speed and pitch separately. Default 0.
_hints.monitor: which monitor: 'primary' or a 0-based monitor index. Default 'primary'.
_hints.mode: how media covers the screen (default 'fit'): fit = keep aspect, letterbox, centered | stretch = squish to screen | cover-height = fit entire screen horizontally (taller media cropped top/bottom) | cover-width = fit entire screen vertically (wider media cropped left/right) | custom = position/scale/flip/rotate (uses position_x/y, scale_x/y, flip, rotation). Old 'cover' was removed — falls back to 'fit'.
_hints.chroma_key: global chroma-key preset: 'off' | 'green' (default) | 'blue' | 'weak green' | 'strong green' | 'weak blue' | 'strong blue'. Presets fill hue/sat/val ranges; explicit ranges still override per-key. Applies to images AND video frames (per-file 'chroma' can override).
_hints.position_x: custom-mode only: X position -1..2 (0 = left edge at screen left, 1 = right edge, 0.5 = centered; outside 0..1 pushes off-screen/peek/crop). Default 0.5.
_hints.position_y: custom-mode only: Y position -1..2 (0 = top, 1 = bottom, 0.5 = centered; outside 0..1 pushes off-screen). Default 0.5.
_hints.scale_x: custom-mode only: width multiplier relative to the 'fit' size (1 = whole media visible, aspect kept). Default 1.0.
_hints.scale_y: custom-mode only: height multiplier relative to the 'fit' size. Default 1.0.
_hints.scale: custom-mode only (per-file): uniform scale setting BOTH scale_x and scale_y (e.g. 'scale': 2 = twice wide AND tall; also accepts a range like '0.5~1.5' — one random draw shared by both axes). Overwritten when BOTH scale_x AND scale_y are given explicitly; a lone scale_x/y overrides just its axis.
_hints.flip_h: custom-mode only: mirror horizontally (true/false). Default false.
_hints.flip_v: custom-mode only: mirror vertically. Default false.
_hints.rotation: custom-mode only: rotation in degrees around the media's center (e.g. 45, -90). Default 0.0.
_hints.volume: global audio volume 0.0-1.0 (per-file sidecar 'volume' overrides for that file). Default 0.8.
_hints.autostart: true = register Windows Run key on every launch (auto-starts at login, silent). false + boot launch (Run key present + --autostart flag) = remove key and exit immediately. false + manual launch = clear stale key, keep running.
_hints.debug: verbose logging to app.log. Default false.
_hints.download_max_height: max video height (px) for the downloader (scripts/download_videos.py). Default 1080.
_hints.rescan_seconds: interval (seconds) for auto-rescanning the media folder for new/removed files. Default 60.
_hints.show_console: true = launch with a visible log terminal; false = hidden background (default). When false on Windows + frozen, the console is detached after config load.
_hints.weight: per-file: pick probability (>= 0; floats allowed; default 1). 2 = twice as likely as a weight-1 file, 0.5 = half. Chance = weight / total_weight across all media. 0 = never picked (logs a warning). Works in ANY mode (not custom-only).
_hints.chroma: per-file override of the global chroma-key flag: true = filter this file, false = skip filtering even when global chroma_key is on (for files that already have real alpha). Default true.

_hints_deprecated: OLD/REMOVED keys no longer valid: 'cover' (mode) was removed — falls back to 'fit'; 'fade_seconds' was renamed to 'fade_out_seconds' (old name still accepted as a deprecated alias); per-file 'chroma_key' was replaced by the per-file boolean 'chroma'; per-file 'no_chroma' naming and the per-item overrides UI were deferred. (Loop/global keys like tick_seconds, odds, autostart, etc. are config.json only — they are not sidecar keys.)
